exposure: Maternal disease diagnostic codes 1 year before conception
Maternal disease diagnostic codes during pregnancy
cohort: Mothers with insurance claims data including newborns treated for neonatal jaundice before birth registration via the National Health Insurance Service-National Sample Cohort
finding: Maternal risk factors for neonatal jaundice included syphilis and leiomyoma during pregnancy, and salpingo-oophoritis before pregnancy, while protective factors included infection, inflammatory diseases, and dyspepsia.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more common in the jaundice group than the control group.
